text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, you came to pick me up! Thank 
you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, you came to pick me up! 
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, all set! Running really does feel 
great!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
B-u-t! Big Sis Maruzen doesn't just stop 
there!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep blasting ahead at full throttle 
until every single one of them is chasing 
right behind me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Good work today! Today's race was super 
exciting!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Both her power and her fighting spirit 
felt like they had completely surpassed 
her previous race.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! More than anything, seeing you 
run looks like so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, my feelings really do get across!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But next time, I'll show you an even more 
incredible race!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Because the next stage is said to hold 
the highest honor—"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
On that magnificent stage, I'll put on the 
ultimate race and captivate everyone!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! I'm so excited! Good luck out 
there!

And so, having safely run her way through 
the grand stage, the next goal in sight is 
the pinnacle of racing, the Japanese 
Derby!
